propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-like tokens (--body-file, --body) as the comment body instead of rejecting them, causing the intended content to be silently discarded while exiting 0
multiple independent sessions have lost recorded attestations and analysis because flag tokens were stored as comment bodies, defeating the documented durability contract of the ticket store
the loss is undetectable at write time because a comment is created (satisfying len check), stderr is silent, and exit code is 0, but the content is empty when later verified
all positional-body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) share the same argument-parsing footgun and must be guarded uniformly
the guard must reject bodies beginning with dash and provide an escape hatch via -- to allow legitimate dash-prefixed values
